events.title: THE COMPANY OF WOLVES (1984)
events.description:
Philadelphia Area Horror Meetup Group
**The Company of Wolves**
1984 - 1hr 35mins
Horror/Fantasy/Body Horror/Dark Comedy

A teenage girl in a country manor falls asleep while reading a magazine, and has a disturbing dream involving wolves prowling the woods below her bedroom window.

*It is widely considered an **influential film**, though not a traditional horror movie. The film is famous for its surreal, dreamlike aesthetic, intricate studio-built forest sets, and grotesque, tactile body-horror transformation scenes.*

*Based on Angela Carter’s short stories (including The Bloody Chamber), it functions as a dark, feminist, psychosexual reimagining of Little Red Riding Hood exploring a young girl's coming-of-age and the predatory nature of men.*
